SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. D. REGISTRY File No. 7496 No. S. B. D. Station, 26 Date August 14, 1936）

Subject Communication dated August 10, 1936 from the Italian Consulate-General regarding Michael Alexandrovich and Miss E.V. Vershinin.
Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by I boyu dss

Enquiries have elicited the information that there is nothing on record, from a criminal or political point of view, to the detriment of either of the applicants for Italian transit visas - Michael Alexandrovich and Miss Elizabeth Vass. Vershinin.

Miss Vershinin has been residing in Shanghai since 1923, when she arrived from Vladivostock in order to escape Soviet rule. She is a "white" Russian and is registered as such with the local Russian Emigrants' Committee, by whom she is favourably regarded. A dressmaker by profession, Miss Vershinin follows this trade in a private capacity, concurrently acting as manageress of the "Cosy Corner" Bar, 18/20 Rue Chu Pao San, French Concession, where she is at present living. The owner of this Bar is one S.M. Palitzer, a Serbian, with whom Miss Vershinin has been co-habiting for a number of years.

Miss Vershinin has a fair amount of money of her own, and her reasons for desiring to leave Shanghai are in order to better herself financially and socially and to regain her health which has suffered considerably during her stay in this city. She has a number of friends and relatives in Belgrade, the capital of Yugo-slavia and it is her intention to open a ladies' dressmaking salon after arrival there.

She is not known to indulge in political activities of any kind.

事由：意大利总领事馆于1936年8月10日来函，关于 Michael Alexandrovich 和 E.V. Vershinin 小姐。
由 D.S. Pitts 撰写。由 I boyu dss 转呈

经查询获悉，就刑事或政治角度而言，申请意大利过境签证的两人——Michael Alexandrovich 和 Elizabeth Vass. Vershinin 小姐——在案记录中均无任何不利记载。

Vershinin 小姐自1923年为逃避苏维埃统治从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达上海后，一直居住于此。她是“白俄”，并在当地俄罗斯侨民委员会注册，该委员会对她评价良好。Vershinin 小姐职业为裁缝，以私人身份从事此业，同时担任法租界朱葆三路（Rue Chu Pao San）18/20号“Cosy Corner”酒吧的女经理，她目前居住在该处。该酒吧老板为一塞尔维亚人 S.M. Palitzer，Vershinin 小姐已与其同居多年。

Vershinin 小姐自有相当数额的积蓄，她希望离开上海的原因是为了改善其经济和社会地位，并恢复因在本市居住期间而严重受损的健康。她在南斯拉夫首都贝尔格莱德有许多朋友和亲戚，打算抵达后开设一家女装裁缝店。

据知，她并未参与任何政治活动。

He accompanied this lady to the Italian Consulate-General when
the latter made her application for the necessary transit visa,
and acted as an interpreter for her. At the same time he also
applied for a visa, as apparently in a moment of weakness, the
lady had previously promised to pay Alexandrovich's passage to
Yugo-slavia, provided that he acted as her interpreter in the
various countries through which they passed and assisted her
in her projected business enterprise in Belgrade. However,
Miss Vershinin regrets having made this promise and there
appears to be some doubt now as to whether she will pay for his
passage. He is in poor circumstances and met Miss Vershinin
at the "Cosy Corner" Bar where he is known for his linguistic
abilities and it was there that his services to act as an
interpreter were accepted.
        He has no means of his own and his trip is contingent
upon the lady paying the passage money and other expenses in-
curred during the voyage. Apart from being of assistance to
Miss Vershinin it is not believed that he has any other plans
in view after arrival in Yugo-slavia.
        Alexandrovich is not known to indulge in political
activities of any kind.

Vershinin 小姐的关系仅仅是翻译。
当这位女士向意大利总领事馆申请必要的过境签证时，
他陪同前往，并担任她的翻译。同时他也申请了签证，因为
显然在一时软弱之下，这位女士此前曾承诺支付 Alexandrovich
前往南斯拉夫的船费，条件是他担任他们在途经各国的翻译，
并协助她在贝尔格莱德计划中的商业企业。然而，
Vershinin 小姐后悔做出了这一承诺，目前看来对于是否
会支付他的船费存在一些疑问。他境况贫寒，是在
“Cosy Corner”酒吧结识 Vershinin 小姐的，他在那里以
语言能力闻名，也是在那里，他担任翻译的服务被接受。
        他身无分文，其行程取决于这位女士是否支付
船费及航行期间产生的其他费用。除了协助
Vershinin 小姐外，据信他在抵达南斯拉夫后并无其他
计划。
        据知，Alexandrovich 并未参与任何政治活动。

(批：dRR 7/8.)
                                        Da Pitts
                                            D.    S.
副总监（刑事及特务科）

CONSOLATO GENERALE D' ITALIA
SHANGHAI

Shanghai, 10th August 1936

Sir,

(批：no record in S/8 Registry 6/88)

Re: 1) Michael Alexandrovich Seaman, age 35, born in
Kiew, passport of the Chinese Ministry of
Foreign Affairs n.296409, May 27th, 1936.
2) Miss Elizabeth V. Vershinin Dressmaker, age 36,
born in Vyatka, Passport of the Chinese Ministry
of Foreign Affairs n.311766, July 23rd 1936.

I have the honour to inform you that the above named
former Russian subjects have applied to this Royal Consulate
General for a viza of transit through Italy with the object
of transferring themselves to Yougoslavia.

They would leave Shanghai together about August 25th.

As they are completely unknown at this Royal Consulate
General I would appreciate it very much if you would kindly let
me have, at your early convenience, all available informations
about them, and especially about their political activity (if any), and
the reason of their planed trip to Yougoslavia.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant

(签名)
Consul General for Italy

COMMISSIONER OF THE POLICE
Shanghai Municipal Council
Shanghai

生于维亚特卡，持中国外交部护照，号码311766，1936年

谨此通知阁下，上述前俄国臣民已向本皇家总
领事馆申请经意大利过境前往南斯拉夫的签证。

他们将于8月25日左右一同离开上海。

由于本皇家总
领事馆对他们完全不了解，如蒙阁下
尽早提供关于他们的所有可用信息，我将不胜感激，特别是关于他们的政治活动（如有），以及
他们计划前往南斯拉夫的原因。

谨此致意，

先生，
